notes: The owner's Test reached his Openfire and came back with the socket's own sentence — *self-signed certificate* — which is the good world: TCP, the stream, STARTTLS and the TLS handshake all worked, and Node refused to trust a private server's out-of-the-box certificate. The trust question was put to the owner with the trade-offs stated, and he chose: allow self-signed, per account. Recorded as his decision, and built the house way. VERIFICATION IS NOT TURNED OFF — IT IS MOVED. The socket still runs Node's verification and reports the verdict and the peer certificate's SHA-256 fingerprint as FA
